rules: Apply source overlays in their frozen deterministic order before global merge.
Preserve source-specific chapter, knowledge-unit, evidence, map, and relation identifiers.
Reject forbidden semantic residue and generic placeholder explanations before indexing.
Require explicit retrieval and embedding eligibility; never infer missing eligibility fields.
Exclude discard, no-value, evidence-only, and unapproved protected content from embeddings.
Do not emit source text, page-level evidence, media, or reconstructive examples in public reports.
